query: Equinix annualized gross bookings record latest quarter
normalized: annualized bookings equinix gross quarter record

output.content:
Equinix reported **$424 million of annualized gross bookings in Q2 2026**, up **23% year over year**; it was the company’s **second-highest quarterly volume on record**, not a new record. [[1]] 

The record remains **$474 million in Q4 2025**, representing **42% year-over-year growth**. [[2]]
